name: ogbn-papers100m: Microsoft Academic Graph Citation Network
description: The ogbn-papers100m dataset is a massive-scale directed citation network of 111,059,956 academic papers indexed by Microsoft Academic Graph (MAG) up to October 2019, connected by 1,615,685,872 directed citation edges. Each paper is associated with a 128-dimensional Word2Vec feature vector extracted from titles and abstracts. The task is to predict the primary subject area among 172 arXiv subject categories for indexed arXiv papers, evaluated under a realistic chronological split (train up to 2017, validation in 2018, test in 2019).
